description: This file declares the CloudStoreImplementation class, which implements the IStore2 and IConfiguration interfaces for a cloud storage component within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes method declarations for configuration, registration, value management, and namespace operations, along with private members for internal store handling.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementation
classes.description: Implements cloud storage and configuration interfaces for the plugin, managing store notifications and value operations.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the cloud store with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback with the store.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback from the store.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the specified namespace with a TTL.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key in the namespace.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from the namespace.
